name: Maid Marian

crownPassive.name: Lady of the greenwood
crownPassive.text: No enemy attack can deal more than 5 damage.

bond.text: If your Robin Hood dies, she gains +2 Attack for the rest of the fight.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Fair fight
actions.text: Attack an enemy hero for 4. If she acts before it this round, it also loses its action.

rules: The 5-damage cap applies after every bonus. Removal effects are not damage, so it doesn't stop them.
